examples.description: Next 12 months of filing deadlines for a Norwegian AS

description: The upcoming filing calendar for one organisation, horizon_months ahead. One entry per obligation and period: obligation_id (the rule_id of get_company_obligations; the public calendar uses other ids), period_label, due_at, adjusted_for with original_due_at, and filing_status. In the sandbox the dates are fixed and far ahead, and horizon_months is ignored; for a real window use get_public_deadlines. Failure modes: NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For the verdict per obligation, use get_company_obligations instead. No API key? Use Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (a fresh suffix) to get fixtures; valid orgs are the 818, 99966 and 99977 series and 999000002 (see GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures). Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing; a shortfall returns INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS with top_up_url). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/norway-corporate-tax-return-deadline
description_nb: Beregn den kommende innleveringskalenderen for et selskap, `horizon_months` (1 til 60) frem: én rad per (forpliktelse, periode) med `obligation_id` (samme rule_id som get_company_obligations), `period_label`, `due_at` i Europe/Oslo, `adjusted_for` med `original_due_at` og `filing_status`. Sandkassesvar har faste datoer langt frem i tid og ignorerer `horizon_months`; for et reelt vindu, bruk get_public_deadlines. Krever read:brreg. For vurdering per forpliktelse, bruk get_company_obligations i stedet. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing; for lav saldo gir INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS med top_up_url).

horizon_months.description: Look-ahead window in months (1–60). Omitted → the endpoint's default horizon (12).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.

name: get_company_deadlines

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The upcoming filing calendar: due_date (Europe/Oslo), legal_reference, recurring + business_day_adjusted per obligation×period.

title: Company filing calendar
